short_scenes.card: Two 10 kΩ divide 12 V, add a 10 kΩ load: V_out?
short_scenes.narration: Two ten kilo-ohm resistors divide twelve volts into six. Now connect a ten kilo-ohm load across the output. What's the output voltage now? Pause and try it!

short_scenes.name: Volt
short_scenes.narration: The load sits in parallel with the bottom resistor, making five kilo-ohms. Twelve times five over fifteen: four volts.
